verdict.rationale: Airweave is a data sync/search layer that syncs and re-indexes source data, but there is no evidence of a memory layer that detects contradictions and updates, supersedes, or merges conflicting memories — the docs describe search modes (vector, agentic) and connectors, not conflict resolution or memory consolidation logic. Missing for 10: any mention of contradiction detection, memory update/merge/supersede semantics, or versioning of conflicting facts.
